aquia-episcopal-church-stafford.assessment: Aquia Episcopal Church is a historic (1757) TEC congregation in Stafford. Built during the colonial era, it is one of the oldest churches in the region. However, as a member of The Episcopal Church, it operates under a denomination that has formally departed from biblical authority on sexuality, gender, and marriage. The same denominational concerns that apply to Trinity Episcopal and St. George's apply here. Historic and beautiful, but institutionally compromised. Not recommended.
